Services

Emergency Assistance
How to access immediate help for food, shelter, and other basic needs.
Food Assistance
Programs for residents who need help paying for food or getting meals.
Financial Assistance
Programs for temporary cash benefits and financial management services.
Housing and Utilities
Programs to help individuals and families find shelter and permanent housing, including veterans and former foster youth.
Healthcare
Information on applying for Medicaid and other health care programs.
Senior Services
Programs for older adults and/or disabled adults to preserve their health, safety, and independence.
Mental Health
Services for children or adults experiencing mental or behavioral concerns.
Child Support
How to establish paternity, request child support, or manage an existing child support case. Information on pursuing legal custody or visitation of a child.
Abuse and Neglect
How to spot the signs of abuse and neglect for children and older adults, along with instructions on how to report suspected cases for investigation.
Foster Care, Adoption, and Kinship
Information for people interested in becoming a foster or adoptive parent. Also, resources and training for current foster parents and caregivers.
Child and Youth Services
Various programs and services to help children and youth before they enter school, during school age, and into young adulthood.
Employment and Job Training
Programs to help clients and returning citizens find work. Also, information about jobs with Cuyahoga County.
Reentry Services
Support services including housing, employment, education, general assistance to help previously incarcerated and/or justice impacted individuals, and their families navigate community reintegration successfully.
Reporting Suspected Public Assistance Fraud
Fraud occurs when a person knowingly and purposely provides false information about their circumstances to obtain benefits.
Education and Training
Find a wide range of programs that support children, teens, young adults, parents, and caregivers with literacy, career development, workforce training, advocacy, and family-focused services.
Cashier Services
Cashier Services provides payment processing, background checks, benefit assistance, voucher and mail pickup, and SNAP Cash-Out services for eligible Cuyahoga County residents.
